hosts.quote-b-api: Forex, precious metals, energy, CFD indices, cryptocurrency
hosts.quote-stock-b-api: US stocks, HK stocks, China A-shares, market indices

endpoints.name: Latest trade price
endpoints.returns: tick_list[]: code, seq, tick_time (ms), price, volume, turnover, trade_direction (0 unknown / 1 buy / 2 sell)

endpoints.name: Order book
endpoints.returns: tick_list[]: code, seq, tick_time (ms), bids[{price,volume}], asks[{price,volume}]
endpoints.note: Book depth varies by venue, not by plan: 10 levels on HK equities, 5 on crypto, 1 on spot metals. CFD indices carry no book at all.

endpoints.name: Historical candles (one code)
params: 0 = latest; a unix ts walks backwards (FX/metals/crypto only)
endpoints.returns: kline_list[]: timestamp (s), open_price, close_price, high_price, low_price, volume, turnover

endpoints.name: Latest 2 candles (many codes)
params: Body, not query string. Returns at most 2 bars per entry.

endpoints.name: Reference / fundamentals
endpoints.returns: static_info_list[]: symbol, name_en/name_cn/name_hk, exchange, board, currency, lot_size, total_shares, circulating_shares, eps, eps_ttm, bps, dividend_yield
endpoints.note: Stock host only. On quote-b-api the same call answers HTTP 200 with the plain-text body "Unable to find matching target resource method" — not JSON, and not an error code. There is no reference data for forex, metals or crypto.

endpoints.name: Halt / resume notices
endpoints.returns: success, timestamp, totalCount, data[]: symbol, symbolName, haltReason, haltDate, haltTime, resumeDate, resumeTime

commands: Send every ~10s or the server drops the connection

kline_types_note: The last column is what the docs claim for equities: 2h and 4h are listed as forex/metals/crypto only.

rows: 1 req / 10 s per endpoint; 10 req/min total

errors: Malformed JSON envelope or data object
Bad token format, or the account expired
Sent as HTTP 429 with body {"error_msg": ...} and no ret/msg fields
Unknown product code, or the code was sent to the wrong host
More codes or candles than the plan allows
The plan does not include this product
too many requests, connection will be closed
